main_text.p: tutos: ac propterea tertiam huic filio fundi partem obuenisse.

In quartæ rationem retenta.) Sic vetus codex: cum alij RATIONE, in sexto ca suscriptum habeant[?]. Quartam intelligimus partis hereditariæ, quæ senatusconsulto Pegasiano cōcessa est ijs, qui partes suas hereditarias restituere rogati sunt. nam cum emolumenti nil ex pectaretur, multi hereditates repudiabant. Unde accidebat, ut neque fideicommissarij quicquam inde consequeretur. Ergo IN QVARTAE RATIONEM RETENTA, hoc'est, in quartam imputata: in partem eius quadrantis, qui rebus alijs complendus erat, attributa. Galli cè dicimus, Super & tanto minus.
Vice mutua percepit.) Nam illius fundi duas partes coheredibus suis cesserat. Vicissim autem ab illis res alias acceperat. Et COMPENSATO dixit, pro Imputato.
Si quid deest.) ad quadrantis absolutionem.
In supplementum deducto.) Aut deducto posuit pro Adiecto, quod ridiculū & ine-

page.notes: The running head is only partly legible. Some abbreviations are uncertain: "ca" before "suscriptum" and the mark over "commissarij" are read with doubt. Long s is written as plain s throughout. The line "u 5 ine-" is at the foot and could be a signature followed by the hyphenated word, so the signature reading is uncertain. The page's last word is hyphenated and continues on the next page.
